summary.en: The ink look: warm paper and black ink, heavy extra-condensed capitals slammed on the beat, one accent that is the dot and everything it becomes, a night ground for the middle, a misregistration ghost on impact frames only.
summary.zh: ink 的样式：暖白纸、黑墨，极窄的粗体大写一拍砸一个，唯一的强调色就是那个墨点和它变成的一切，中段用夜色底，只在砸下那一帧有套印错位的残影。

fits: Launch films and teasers cut hard to a beat, 20–45 s: a dev tool with one sharp claim, a name to land on a drop.
notFor: Calm explainers; screenshots or UI as the subject; many numbers; long sentences.

intent.en: Type as percussion: every word is a hit on paper, and one dot carries every cut, so the film reads as one gesture.
intent.zh: 把字当打击乐：每个词都是砸在纸上的一下，一个墨点串起每次切换，整支片像一笔写完。

content.en: One- or two-word statements (≤ 10 chars a word), a name, two or three labels, a number, one claim, a command.
content.zh: 一两个词的短句（每词 ≤ 4 字），一个名字，两三条标签，一个数，一句断言，一行命令。

fits.zh: 踩拍硬剪的发布片和预告，20–45 秒：一个有尖锐主张的开发者工具，一个要落在 drop 上的名字。

notFor.zh: 安静的讲解片；以截图或界面为主体；数字很多；长句。

pairs.note: its sound: a stamp per slam, two drops

en: The accent is only the dot and what it becomes; never colour a word with it except the warped one.
The misregistration ghost lives one tenth of a second on impact frames; never as a resting style.
zh: 强调色只给墨点和它变成的东西；除了扭曲的那个词，不给任何字上色。
套印残影只在砸下的 0.1 秒出现，不能当静止样式。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
